description: This file defines an interface ITypeManifestProvider for providing type manifest information, and an abstract base class TypeManifestProviderBase for generated type manifest providers, implementing the interface and providing common configuration logic.

classes.name: ITypeManifestProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing type manifest information, inheriting from IConfigureOptions with TypeManifestOptions.

classes.name: TypeManifestProviderBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for generated type manifest providers, implementing ITypeManifestProvider and providing default configuration logic.

methods.name: ConfigureInner
methods.description: Abstract method to configure type manifest options, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Virtual property providing a unique identifier for the provider, defaulting to the provider's type.
